name: Grommul Forgemaster (CR 1/2)
body:
GROMMUL FORGEMASTER
CR 1/2

This short, porcine humanoid has an upturned nose and flabby jowls. He wears a heavy apron and carries a heavy crossbow.

XP 200
Grommul mechanic 1
LN Small humanoid (grommul)
Init +1; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +4

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 12, flat-footed 14 (+1 size, +1 Dex, +1 natural, +2 armor)
hp 11 (1d8+2+1)
Fort +4, Ref +3, Will +0; +2 vs. charm and compulsion
Defensive Abilities stubborn; Resist cold 5, fire 5

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee masterwork warhammer +4 (1d6+3/×3 B; crush, shove)
Ranged synthetic heavy crossbow +3 (1d8 P, 19-20/×2, range incr. 120 ft.; AP 2; move action to reload)
Special Attacks combat tracking (+1)

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 13, Con 14, Int 16, Wis 10, Cha 6
Base Atk +0; CMB +0; CMD 12
Feats Rapid Reload (heavy crossbow), Skill Focus (Disable Device), TechnologistTG
Skills Climb +6, Craft (mechanical) +7, Craft (weapons) +9, Disable Device +9, Heal +4, Knowledge (engineering) +8, Perception +4; Species Modifiers +2 Craft (weapons), +1 Disable Device, +1 Knowledge (engineering)
Languages Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Grommul, Ubo
SQ artificial intelligence (exocortex), custom rig (max. 2,500 ft.), master tinker, memory module
Gear NPC gear (Small carbonfiber armor, Small masterwork warhammer, Small synthetic heavy crossbow with 10 bolts, Small artisan’s tools, other gear)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Master Tinker (Ex)

A grommul is treated as proficient with any weapon they have personally crafted.

Stubborn (Ex)

If a grommul fails a save against an enchantment (charm) or enchantment (compulsion) spell or spell-like ability, they receive another save 1 round later (at the same DC) to end the effect.

ABOUT

Grommuls are hard workers, throwing themselves into their tasks. They appreciate those who acknowledge their handiwork, but are easily offended by those who would waste their time with small talk.
